title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_offsite_uploaded}
description: Phase 8 §8.12 — notification emitted by maint.backup.v1 after a successful offsite upload. Notification only.

uploaded_bytes.description: Total bytes transferred to the offsite target.

manifest_checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the uploaded manifest file; empty string when offsite target does not verify.

resumed_from_state.description: True when the upload resumed an interrupted multipart session.

backup_id.description: Deprecated — not emitted by the current agent; retained for schema evolution.
